evidence.quote: Non-EU/EEA Citizens EUR 1,500 EUR 211 EUR 1,711 Tuition fee based on passport nationality
For international non-EU applicants this deadline is 31 May.
Deadlines for Non-EU applicants: Winter semester: May 31st

Foreign and stateless prospective students with a higher education entrance qualification obtained abroad (except EU citizens) can apply directly to the desired degree program via the applicant portal.

notes: Tuition fee of EUR 1,500 per semester applies to non-EU/EEA citizens based on passport nationality; exempted for those with German higher education entrance qualification, recognised refugees, or Erasmus+ students. Documents are not listed on the programme page.
